desc:
ALL SLIMES NOW SAVE EVEN ON THE FLOOR!

👍 THUMBS UP for more UPDATES and a FREE CODE at 50,000 LIKES 👍

🖥️ PC Controls:

E or Click - Pickup / Place slime
E - Drop slime
Numbers - Switch slimes
T - Unlock Mouse
G - Magic Ability
Click - Play with Slime

🎮 Controller Controls:

RT - Pickup / Place slime
LT - Drop slime
Upgrades - Y
Hold LT - Play with Slime

🧸 Your local Slime Store has been turned upside down and the slimes are everywhere! Unlock your inner collector and help clean up the mess by sorting thousands of adorable slimes scattered around the entire store!

👥 Cleanup alone or with friends!
⚔️ Play against real players in a 1v1 mode!
🏁 Race for the fastest times on the leaderboard!
🔓 Earn upgrades and abilities to help make the job easier!

✨ Inspired by cute cleanup and collecting games ✨
